name: reporting_feedback_export
description: Export every piece of feedback / evidence in an assessment cycle, one row each, for monthly reporting (tenant admins only): recipient and provider with their roles, direction, requested or proactive (a request made here), where it was given (origin) and the request it answered there, type, title, the feedback text, the behaviours it applies to, and status. The rows match the feedback the cycle's coverage report counts as provided; include_withdrawn adds the withdrawn items it reports separately. Pass month (YYYY-MM) to narrow to feedback recorded in one calendar month. The response carries every row's full text, so a month is far smaller than a whole cycle; for counts alone use reporting_evidence_coverage.

cycle_id.description: An assessment cycle's id, from reporting_cycles_list.

month.description: Calendar month within the cycle, YYYY-MM. Omit for the whole cycle.
